question: In a group of six people, each has a different height. Reshma is the tallest and Kavita is taller than Surbhi, who is shorter than Lalita. Pallavi is taller than Ganga but shorter than Surbhi. Kavita is taller than Lalita. Who among the following is the shortest?
solution:
Given: Six people.

1) Reshma is the tallest.

Reshma > __ > __ > __ > __ > __

2) Kavita is taller than Surbhi, who is shorter than Lalita.

Kavita > Surbhi

Lalita > Surbhi

3) Kavita is taller than Lalita.
